arxiv-2009-10743.title: Nucleation is More than Critical A Case Study of the Electroweak Phase Transition in the NMSSM Preprint: FERMILAB-PUB-20-490-T 0 EFI-20-18 0 WSU-HEP-2004
arxiv-2009-10743.creator: Sebastian Baum, Marcela Carena, Nausheen R. Shah, Carlos E. M. Wagner, Yikun Wang
arxiv-2009-10743.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Sebastian Baum, Marcela Carena, Nausheen R. Shah, Carlos E. M. Wagner, Yikun Wang. Electroweak baryogenesis is an attractive mechanism to generate the baryon asymmetry of the Universe via a strong first order electroweak phase transition. We compare the phase transition patterns suggested by the vacuum structure at the critical temperatures , at which local minima are degenerate, with those obtained from computing the probability for nucleation via tunneling through the barrier separating local minima.

arxiv-2106-02580.title: How cost impacts equitable participation in astronomy outreach events Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 )
arxiv-2106-02580.creator: Melanie Archipley, Hannah S. Dalgleish
arxiv-2106-02580.description: Abstract The International Astronomical Youth Camp (IAYC) is an astronomy education outreach event with more than 50 years of history and over 1,700 unique participants from 81 nationalities. The International Workshop for Astronomy e.V. (IWA) is the non-profit organization behind the IAYC, established in 1979 and based in Germany.

arxiv-2206-13053.title: Run and Frequency quotas for q q -binary trials
arxiv-2206-13053.creator: Jungtaek Oh
arxiv-2206-13053.description: Abstract We study the distributions of waiting times in variations of the q q -sooner and later waiting time problem. One variation imposes length and frequency quotas on the runs of successes and failures. Another case considers binary trials for which the probability of ones is geometrically varying.

arxiv-2405-15058.title: Remoteness of graphs with given size and connectivity constraints
arxiv-2405-15058.creator: Peter Dankelmann, Sonwabile Mafunda, Sufiyan Mallu
arxiv-2405-15058.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Peter Dankelmann, Sonwabile Mafunda, Sufiyan Mallu. Let G G be a finite, simple connected graph. The average distance of a vertex v v of G G is the arithmetic mean of the distances from v v to all other vertices of G G . The remoteness ρ ⁡ ( G ) \rho(G) of G G is the maximum of the average distances of the vertices of G G .

arxiv-2408-14878.title: Analysing Hubble Tension and Gravitational Waves for f ⁡ ( Q , T ) f(Q,T) Gravity Theories
arxiv-2408-14878.creator: Shreya Banerjee, Aritrya Paul
arxiv-2408-14878.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shreya Banerjee, Aritrya Paul. In this work, we examine viable models of f ⁡ ( Q , T ) f(Q,T) gravity theories against observational data with the aim to constrain the parameter space of these models. We have analysed five different models of f ⁡ ( Q , T ) f(Q,T) gravity and tested them against Type Ia supernovae, Cosmic Chronometer data, Baryon Acoustic Oscillations data and Pantheon data.

arxiv-2503-01979.title: French Onion Soup, Ipelets for Points and Polygons
arxiv-2503-01979.creator: Klint Faber, Auguste H. Gezalyan, Adam Martinson, Aniruddh Mutnuru, Nithin Parepally, Ryan Parker, Mihil Sreenilayam, Aram Zaprosyan, David M. Mount
arxiv-2503-01979.description: Abstract There are many structures, both classical and modern, involving point-sets and polygons whose deeper understanding can be facilitated through interactive visualizations. The Ipe extensible drawing editor, developed by Otfried Cheong, is a widely used software system for generating geometric figures. One of its features is the capability to extend its functionality through programs called Ipelets.

arxiv-2503-20387.title: Electric Field Distortions in Surface Ion Traps with Integrated Nanophotonics
arxiv-2503-20387.creator: Guochun Du 1, Elena Jordan 1 , Tanja E. Mehlstäubler 1,2,3
arxiv-2503-20387.description: Abstract The integration of photonic components into surface ion traps provides a scalable approach for trapped-ion quantum computing, sensing, and metrology, enabling compact systems with enhanced stability and precision. However, the introduction of optical apertures in the trap electrodes can distort the trapping electric field.

arxiv-2510-15826.title: Quantifying the Risk of Long-Term Chikungunya Persistence in Miami-Dade County Thanks: Research was partially supported by National Science Foundation grant (DMS-2424605).
arxiv-2510-15826.creator: Antonio Gondim, Leonardo Schultz, Xi Huo, Shigui Ruan
arxiv-2510-15826.description: Abstract Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a mosquito-borne arbovirus with the potential to establish sustained transmission in subtropical regions like Florida, where climatic and ecological conditions support vector proliferation. In this study, we develop a Continuous-Time Markov Chain (CTMC) model to assess the probability of long-term CHIKV establishment in Miami-Dade County following repeated introductions of external infectious individuals.

arxiv-2510-27504.title: DP-FedPGN: Finding Global Flat Minima for Differentially Private Federated Learning via Penalizing Gradient Norm Thanks: Fanhua Shang, Junkang Liu, and Daorui Ding, Junchao Zhou are with the School of Computer Science and Technology, College of Intelligence and Computing, Tianjin University, Tianjin
arxiv-2510-27504.creator: Junkang Liu, Yuxuan Tian, Fanhua Shang, Senior Member, IEEE, Hongying Liu, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2510-27504.description: Abstract To prevent inference attacks in Federated Learning (FL) and reduce the leakage of sensitive information, Client-level Differentially Private Federated Learning (CL-DPFL) is widely used. However, current CL-DPFL methods usually result in sharper loss landscapes, which leads to a decrease in model generalization after differential privacy protection.

arxiv-2511-16905.title: Predicting Talent Breakout Rate using Twitter and TV data Thanks: Originally presented at the 34th Annual Conference of the Japanese Society for Artificial Intelligence (JSAI 2020), paper ID 1K3-ES-2-02. Corresponding authors: hiroyuki.fukuda@dentsu.co.jp , batsaikhan.bilguun@dentsu.co.jp .
arxiv-2511-16905.creator: Batsaikhan Bilguun, Hiroyuki Fukuda
arxiv-2511-16905.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Batsaikhan Bilguun, Hiroyuki Fukuda. Early detection of rising talents is of paramount importance in the field of advertising. In this paper, we define a concept of talent breakout and propose a method to detect Japanese talents before their rise to stardom. The main focus of the study is to determine the effectiveness of combining Twitter and TV data on predicting time-dependent changes in social data.

arxiv-2512-03706.title: Consistent Projection of Langevin Dynamics: Preserving Thermodynamics and Kinetics in Coarse-Grained Models
arxiv-2512-03706.creator: Vahid Nateghi, Lara Neureither, Selma Moqvist, Carsten Hartmann, Simon Olsson, Feliks Nüske
arxiv-2512-03706.description: Abstract Coarse graining (CG) is an important task for efficient modeling and simulation of complex multi-scale systems, such as the conformational dynamics of biomolecules. This work presents a projection-based coarse-graining formalism for general underdamped Langevin dynamics. Following the Zwanzig projection approach, we derive a closed-form expression for the coarse grained dynamics.

arxiv-2603-08979.title: Data-driven robust Markov decision processes on Borel spaces: performance guarantees via an axiomatic approach
arxiv-2603-08979.creator: Sivaramakrishnan Ramani

pmc-11363847.title: Numerical and computational analysis on a dissipative dynamical system: Slow invariant manifold for complex chemical mechanism
pmc-11363847.creator: Xiao Xin, Faisal Sultan, Muhammad Yaseen, El-Sayed M. Sherif, Muhammad Shoaib Ishaq
pmc-11363847.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This article presents the notion about Slow Invariant Manifold (SIM) and their fundamental role in model reduction techniques (MRTs) for challenges encountered in mechanical engineering within dissipative systems of chemical kinetics. Focusing on the reaction routes of complex mechanisms, we construct and compare primary approximations of the SIM through MRTs, including the Spectral Quasi Equilibrium Manifold (SQEM) and Intrinsic Low Dimensional Manifold (ILDM).

pmc-11401323.title: Factors affecting neurological outcomes of patients with sudden cardiac arrest in the emergency department
pmc-11401323.creator: Kyeongmin Jang, Hye-Min Hwang, Yon Hee Seo
pmc-11401323.description: BackgroundLittle is known about patients with sudden cardiac arrest in the emergency department (ED). This study aimed to identify factors affecting the prognosis of patients with cardiac arrest in the ED. MethodsThis retrospective study analyzed patients with sudden cardiac arrest admitted to the ED of a general hospital between January 2016 and July 2020.

pmc-11515783.title: Racial biases in clinical practice and medical education: a scoping review
pmc-11515783.creator: Adil Mouhab, Rahmeth Radjack, Marie Rose Moro, Mathilde Lambert
pmc-11515783.description: IntroductionHealth inequalities represent a major challenge in contemporary medicine, with some attributed to racial biases. Recently, in the United States, a call to combat discrimination in the field of health has resonated, particularly in the context of the COVID-19 crisis, in which minorities have been disproportionately affected.

pmc-12368225.title: Stacking ensemble learning models diagnose pulmonary infections using host transcriptome data from metatranscriptomics
pmc-12368225.creator: Tian Zhang, Ying Deng, Wentao Wang, Zhe Zhao, Yiling Wu, Haoqian Wang, Shutao Xia, Weifang Liao, Weijie Liao
pmc-12368225.description: The prompt diagnosis of pulmonary infections with unknown etiology in patients in severe condition remains a challenge due to the lack of rapid and effective diagnostic methods. While metatranscriptomic sequencing offers a powerful approach, its clinical utility is often limited by issues of timeliness.

pmc-12492562.title: A case of ADH5/ALDH2 deficiency combined with 3q29 microduplication syndrome
pmc-12492562.creator: Shu Chenzhuo, Fu Lingling, Wei Ang, Chen Hui, Wang Ruixin, Yang Bixi, Li Hongmin, Ma Jie, Wang Tianyou
pmc-12492562.description: A case of ADH5/ALDH2 deficiency combined with 3q29 microduplication syndrome in the Department of Hematology, Beijing Children’s hospital was retrospectively analyzed. The child, a 3-year-old girl, had a history of recurrent cutaneous petechias, and multiple episodes of pancytopenia. She was examined for café au lait spots, growth retardation, and microcephaly.

pmc-12566391.title: Harnessing Biogenic Silica: Nanoarchitected Pt3Pd1 on Nettle-Derived N,Si-CQDs for High-Performance Methanol Electrooxidation
pmc-12566391.creator: Seden Beyhan, Mohammed Es-Souni
pmc-12566391.description: This study introduces nitrogen- and silicon-containing carbon quantum dots (N,Si-CQDs), synthesized hydrothermally from the sustainable bioresource stinging nettle (Urtica dioica L.), as chemically active supports for Pt, Pd, and Pt3Pd1 electrocatalysts. The N,Si-CQDs were characterized by a high concentration of N/O surface functionalities and the presence of biogenic Si.

pmc-12707442.title: Transitions in Sarcopenia Status and Cognitive Trajectories Among Middle-Aged and Older Adults in China: Longitudinal Cohort Study
pmc-12707442.creator: Chun Luo, Hao Wu, Xiaoying Shen, Shuang Han, Lv Lin, Bingyang Liu, Pui Hing Chau
pmc-12707442.description: BackgroundBaseline sarcopenia has been linked to cognitive decline in older adults; however, the impact of longitudinal changes in sarcopenia status on cognitive trajectories remains unclear.ObjectiveThis aims to examine the association between 2-year transitions in sarcopenia status and subsequent 5-year cognitive trajectories among middle-aged and older adults in China.MethodsWe analyzed data from 8189 participants (median age 58, IQR y; n=432952.

pmc-12999890.title: Fixation for calcaneal tuberosity fracture (beak fracture) using preformed “L-shape” hook plate
pmc-12999890.creator: Qiang Zhang, Wei Huang, Zongde Wu
pmc-12999890.description: ObjectivesSurgical management of calcaneal tuberosity fractures is challenging, as patient outcomes can be compromised by skin flap necrosis and implant failure. We propose a technique utilizing a prefabricated L-shaped hook plate, which represents an innovative clinical orthopedic surgical approach.MethodsIn this retrospective study, patients with Beavis type II calcaneal tuberosity fractures underwent internal fixation using a preformed “L-shape” hook plate (2015–2020).

pmc-13053667.title: Magnitude of Hypertension and Associated Factors Among Diabetic Patients at Hawassa University Comprehensive Specialized Hospital, Ethiopia: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13053667.creator: Yazachew Mossu, Amanuel Anegagregn, Kinde Wubeshet, Akberet Semere, Ermias Abera, Endrias Markos, Teketel Tadesse
pmc-13053667.description: Background and AimsHypertension (HTN) is a frequent comorbidity in patients with diabetes mellitus (DM), increasing the risk of cardiovascular and renal complications. Despite global recognition of the coexistence of HTN and DM, region‐specific data in southern Ethiopia, particularly the Sidama region, remain limited.

pmc-13284621.title: The Predictive Value of the Tumor‐Stroma Ratio for Neoadjuvant Endocrine Therapy in Hormone Receptor‐Positive Breast Cancer
pmc-13284621.creator: Layla Andour, Sophie C. Hagenaars, Anne Florine de Groot, Elly M. M. Krol‐Warmerdam, Judith R. Kroep, Hans Marten Hazelbag, Gerrit‐Jan Liefers, Marieke E. Straver, Wilma E. Mesker
pmc-13284621.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Approximately 75% of breast cancers are hormone receptor‐positive (HR+). Endocrine therapy may be administered to improve survival. Neoadjuvant therapy may enable breast‐ and axilla‐conserving surgery, but identifying who will benefit remains challenging. This study evaluates the predictive value of the tumor‐stroma ratio (TSR) for response to neoadjuvant endocrine therapy (NET) and examines the accuracy of MRI in predicting (near) pathological complete response (pCR).

pmc-13437584.title: AMPA receptor modulation in depression: from molecular mechanisms of plasticity to therapeutic translation
pmc-13437584.creator: Wojciech Ziemichód, Natalia Kajka, Klaudia Kister, Karolina Kasprzak, Kaja Karakuła, Dariusz Juchnowicz

pmc-13455162.title: Assessment of prevalence, perceptions, and factors associated with reported history of caesarean section among women in the United Arab Emirates: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13455162.creator: Alantreesa Siby, Amal Shaji, Fathimath Shahza, Richu Elsa Shaju, Wajiha Ajmal, Nelofar Sami Khan
pmc-13455162.description: BackgroundCaesarean section (CS) is a life-saving intervention when medically indicated; however, its use has increased substantially worldwide, including in high-access healthcare settings. Emerging evidence suggests that women’s perceptions, prior childbirth experiences, and counselling practices may contribute to persistently elevated CS rates.

pmc-13563735.title: Epidemiological characteristics and spatiotemporal analysis of scarlet fever in Guangzhou, China: the surveillance of 20 years
pmc-13563735.creator: Hong-rou Lin, Jiangrong Wang, Jiamin Shan, Qing He, Shuwen Dong, Qiang Deng, Meiqi Zhang, Siyu Chen, Lei Luo, Yilan Li, Yanhui Liu

pmc-13658224.title: MAP2K6 reprograms NAD+ metabolism via the HMGA1–NAMPT axis to sensitize ovarian cancer cells to PARP inhibition
pmc-13658224.creator: Ming Wen, Zhuohang Chen, Dongdong Zhan, Mingwei Liu, Shuran Tan, Fang Zhu, Siyu Yang, Jinru Xie, Yu Zhang, Jianjian Li, Lunquan Sun, Rong Tan
pmc-13658224.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PARP inhibitors (PARPi) selectively target cancers with homologous recombination deficiency (HRD), yet emerging evidence suggests that additional determinants beyond BRCA/HRD status modulate PARPi response. Here, by integrating unbiased proteomic profiling with systematic drug-response phenotyping across 11 ovarian cancer cell lines, we identify MAP2K6 as a previously unrecognized regulator of PARP1 activation and an important determinant of PARP inhibitor sensitivity in BRCA-wild-type ovarian cancer.
